POLICY COMMITTEE MEETING 
MONDAY, NOVEMBER 9, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Policy Committee was held at NHS North on Monday, November 9, 2026.   
Ms. Raymond called the meeting to order at 6:18 pm.  
 
Present: Ms. Raymond, Mr. Johnson, Ms. Lamphier, Mr. Salvi, Ms. Lopez, and Ms. Giglio 
 
Also Present: Mr. O’Rourke 
 
Also Present: Members of the Public, Channel 22 Videographer 
 
Policy ADC – Religious Neutrality & Religious Accommodations 
• Clarified religious expression rights and limits on religious promotion by school staff and volunteers. 
• Discussed student observances, excused absences, make-up work, and the possibility of publishing a 
religious-holiday calendar online. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Ms. Lamphier, to approve policy ACD – Religious Neutrality & Religious 
Accommodations.  Motion passed 3-0. 
 
Policy EBCA – Crisis Prevention and Emergency Operations Plans 
• EBCA’s emergency operations plan deadline was changed to be before the start of each school year; the 
committee voted to forward the policy to the full board. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Mr. Johnson, to approve policy EBCA – Crisis Prevention and Emergency 
Operations Plans.  Motion passed 3-0. 
 
Policy EBCF – Pandemic/Epidemic Emergencies 
• EBCF was reviewed following the state masking-law change; no policy changes were recommended, 
and the committee voted to forward it. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Mr. Johnson, to approve policy EBCF – Pandemic/Epidemic 
Emergencies.  Motion passed 3-0. 
 
Policy KFA – Conduct on School Property 
• Discussed written trespass notices, a 35-day limit, appeals, and possible extensions of up to one year 
with board approval. 
• The committee voted to forward KFA and discussed waiving its second reading because of the law’s 
effective date. 
• The superintendent’s office was identified as the channel for appeals. The board’s review of existing 
trespass orders and the legal interpretation remained under consideration. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Mr. Johnson, to policy KFA – Conduct on School Property.  Motion 
passed 3-0. 
 
Future Plans 
• Board member asked for clarification of public comment at Special BOE meetings or committee 
meetings. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Ms. Lamphier, to adjourn at 7:16 pm.  Motion passes 3-0.  
 
Submitted by Tara C. Kinsella
